title: BPW-2026-0454
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0454
CD 10
REVISED TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 17-065A – PIO PICO LIBRARY POCKET PARK PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a second revision of the task for TOS No. 17-065A to Kleinfelder, Inc., increasing the budget authority from $218,410 to $260,635 for geotechnical and environmental engineering services for the Pio Pico Library Pocket Park Project.
(W.O.: E1908188, C-141867)
